Build shared notification delivery core (#138)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-29
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - Add the stable provider-neutral notification delivery crate and reuse the canonical v1 semantic envelope.
    - Freeze destination, binding, rendered payload, idempotency, receipt, and fence identities behind validated public types.
    - Define pure render/exact-send provider contracts, application-owned store ports, deterministic retry policy, and common fenced worker transitions.
    - Cover cancellation, lease loss, stale fences, deadlines, retry exhaustion, bounded provider delay, timeout, panic containment, and exact payload replay.
    - Update OpenWiki ownership guidance for the new shared boundary.
    
    ## Verification
    
    - `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
    - `cargo clippy -p codeoo-notification-core --all-targets -- -D warnings`
    - `cargo test -p codeoo-notification-core`
    - `RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc -p codeoo-notification-core --no-deps`
    - `cargo tree -p codeoo-notification-core --depth 1`
